fruit.grandline.tako_kraken.desc: ORIGINAL — Octo-Octo Fruit, Model: Kraken (Mythical Zoan): become the sea monster sailors fear most. Eight crushing arms, ink clouds, and the strength to wrap a warship and break its hull. Transformed, blunt blows are cushioned and lost flesh regrows.
ability.grandline.fruit.tako_kraken.tran: Cycle human → hybrid → full kraken (awakened form after awakening).
ability.grandline.fruit.tako_kraken.tent: A wide sweep of arms; whoever is struck is dragged towards you.
ability.grandline.fruit.tako_kraken.ink_: Blinds everything in front with ink while the jet throws you backwards out of reach.
ability.grandline.fruit.tako_kraken.cons: Seize one target in your arms, hold it fast and squeeze it over three seconds.
ability.grandline.fruit.tako_kraken.ship: Wrap the nearest enemy ship and crush its hull. With no ship near, haul your target into the air and smash it down.
ability.grandline.fruit.tako_kraken.abys: Colossal arms burst up in a ring, drag everyone inside to the centre (and under, at sea) and crush any ship caught in them.
fruit.grandline.rasen.desc: ORIGINAL — Spiral-Spiral Fruit: make anything you touch spiral. Corkscrew blows that bore through guards, spring-coiled legs, a twist that wrenches bodies around, spiral staircases and a drilling screw-lance. Immune to impact; no fall damage.
A twisting punch that bores straight through any guard along a short line.
ability.grandline.fruit.rasen.coil_sprin: Coil your legs and launch; landing drives a shockwave into the ground.
ability.grandline.fruit.rasen.twist.desc: Wrench a target around: it faces the wrong way, reeling, slowed and losing its target.
ability.grandline.fruit.rasen.spiral_sta: A helix of steps rises around you (temporary) and hurls enemies at its foot upward.
ability.grandline.fruit.rasen.screw_lanc: A spinning lance that drills through enemies and soft stone and twists what it pierces.
ability.grandline.fruit.rasen.helix_asce: The ground spirals upward at a point, lifting enemies along a helix, then slams them down.
fruit.grandline.tsuchi.desc: ORIGINAL — Soil-Soil Fruit (Logia): your body is earth. Clods, walls, landslides, burrowing and earthen prisons. The soil body is only intangible while touching the ground; it grounds lightning (immune) but water turns it to mud.
ability.grandline.fruit.tsuchi.clod_shot: A fist of hardened earth that leaves the target heavy-legged.
ability.grandline.fruit.tsuchi.earth_wal: Raise a wall of packed earth; enemies where it rises are thrown back.
ability.grandline.fruit.tsuchi.landslide: A rolling wave of earth runs along the ground, tossing enemies and burying their feet.
ability.grandline.fruit.tsuchi.burrow.de: Sink into the earth and erupt beneath your target with an uppercut of soil.
ability.grandline.fruit.tsuchi.earth_pri: The ground swallows the target in packed earth, crushing and holding it.
ability.grandline.fruit.tsuchi.tectonic_: Earth pillars erupt across the area, launching whoever stands on them.
fruit.grandline.kiri.desc: ORIGINAL — Fog-Fog Fruit (Logia): become sea mist. Water jets that reach Logia users, vanishing mist, fog banks and a sea fog that hides a whole crew, and mist that drowns foes on dry land. Wind scatters you (always connects, +50%).
A jet of condensed mist — real water, so it splashes even Logia bodies.
ability.grandline.fruit.kiri.vanishing_m: Burst into mist: nearby enemies are blinded and lose you as you drift away unseen.
ability.grandline.fruit.kiri.fog_bank.de: Thick fog rolls over an area: enemies are blinded, slowed and lose track; allies inside vanish.
ability.grandline.fruit.kiri.drowning_mi: Mist condenses in the target's lungs — it drowns on dry land. Water-breathers only feel the chill.
ability.grandline.fruit.kiri.sea_fog.des: A vast sea fog follows you for a long while: your crew (and ship) vanish from enemy eyes.
ability.grandline.fruit.kiri.white_abyss: A dome of mist becomes a freezing downpour, then freezes solid around everyone inside.
fruit.grandline.tenbin.desc: ORIGINAL — Scale-Scale Fruit: weigh and balance. Make things heavy or light, even out the health of two bodies, move your ailments onto an enemy and judge a foe by the weight of their crimes. No single blow can tip your scales too far.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenbin.weigh_dow: Add weight to a target: slowed and dragged out of the air.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenbin.featherwe: You and nearby allies become weightless: fast, high-jumping, falling like feathers.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenbin.equilibri: Balance your health with the target's: whoever is healthier pays the difference.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenbin.burden_sw: Every ailment on you moves onto the target, and the target's blessings move to you.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenbin.judgement: The heavier the target's crimes (bounty, notoriety, outlaw allegiance), the harder the verdict falls.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenbin.absolute_: A field where enemies grow crushingly heavy and allies light; at the end every enemy is levelled to the weakest of them.
fruit.grandline.hari.desc: ORIGINAL — Needle-Needle Fruit: grow and fire needles. Volleys, a bristling skin, pressure points that lock a body up, caltrops sown as a trap and healing acupuncture for the crew. Close attackers are always pricked.
Your body bristles with needles: close attackers are skewered and blows are blunted.
ability.grandline.fruit.hari.pressure_po: A needle into a nerve cluster: the target locks up, unable to move or guard.
ability.grandline.fruit.hari.caltrops.de: Needles sown over the ground: a trap that pricks, slows and bleeds anyone walking through.
ability.grandline.fruit.hari.acupuncture: Heal yourself and nearby allies, shake off ailments and fight harder.
ability.grandline.fruit.hari.needle_rain: A storm of needles rains from the sky over an area.
fruit.grandline.hoshi.desc: ORIGINAL — Star-Star Fruit (Logia): become starlight. Shooting stars, gravity wells that swallow even arrows, a comet's dash, starfall, constellations and a supernova. Stronger under the night sky; darkness swallows starlight.
ability.grandline.fruit.hoshi.shooting_s: A streak of starlight that bursts on impact.
ability.grandline.fruit.hoshi.gravity_we: A collapsed star drags everything in — even arrows and bullets — then bursts.
ability.grandline.fruit.hoshi.comet_dash: Streak forward as a comet, burning through everyone in the way.
ability.grandline.fruit.hoshi.starfall.d: Stars rain down on an area, each burst leaving a small crater.
ability.grandline.fruit.hoshi.constellat: Up to six enemies are marked as stars, then struck by lines of light and dragged together.
Become a dying star: everything is dragged in, then a blinding blast.
fruit.grandline.mitsu.desc: ORIGINAL — Honey-Honey Fruit (Logia): become golden honey. Sticky globs, pools of real honey that glue feet down, a lure that draws enemies to you, royal jelly that heals and feeds the crew, and amber coffins. Attackers come away stuck; fire caramelises you (+30%).
ability.grandline.fruit.mitsu.honey_shot: A heavy glob of honey that sticks the target in place.
ability.grandline.fruit.mitsu.honey_trap: The ground at a point floods with honey: feet stick, movement crawls.
ability.grandline.fruit.mitsu.sweet_lure: An irresistible scent: enemies are drawn to you and fixate on you.
ability.grandline.fruit.mitsu.royal_jell: Heal and feed yourself and nearby allies and coat them in a protective glaze.
ability.grandline.fruit.mitsu.amber_coff: Seal the target in honey that sets like amber.
ability.grandline.fruit.mitsu.honey_floo: A golden flood buries the area; everyone inside is glued, smothered, then set hard.
fruit.grandline.kabi.desc: ORIGINAL — Mould-Mould Fruit (Logia): become a living colony of mould. Spore clouds, a mycelium carpet that roots enemies and feeds allies, rot that eats flesh and ship timber, and puffball sentries. Immune to poison; fire burns you (+50%, always connects).
A puff of spores that bursts on whoever it hits.
ability.grandline.fruit.kabi.spore_cloud: A cloud of choking spores: poison, nausea and weakness; enemies lose track.
ability.grandline.fruit.kabi.mycelium.de: Mould spreads over the ground: enemies on it are rooted and sickened, allies are fed.
ability.grandline.fruit.kabi.rot.desc: Mould eats into a target — and into the timber of an enemy ship near the aim point.
ability.grandline.fruit.kabi.puffball_se: Three puffballs sprout around you and keep spraying spores at enemies on their own.
ability.grandline.fruit.kabi.blight.desc: The colony blooms over the whole area: every enemy rots and enemy ships nearby are eaten through.
fruit.grandline.funa.desc: ORIGINAL — Ship-Ship Fruit: your body holds the spirit of a ship. Arm cannons, a gangplank across the water, a ship that sails itself wherever you look (even in the Calm Belt), hull repairs, a prow ram and a phantom fleet. Standing on a ship, its hull slowly mends.
ability.grandline.fruit.funa.broadside.d: Cannons sprout from your arms and fire a three-gun salvo.
ability.grandline.fruit.funa.gangplank.d: A bridge of planks unrolls from your feet across water or a gap (temporary).
ability.grandline.fruit.funa.living_ship: Your ship comes alive: anchor up, sails set, sailing itself wherever you look — wind or no wind.
ability.grandline.fruit.funa.hull_mend.d: Timber knits back into your ship's hull and the crew on deck catch their breath.
ability.grandline.fruit.funa.prow_ram.de: Ram forward like a prow: creatures are thrown aside and enemy ships take a crushing blow.
ability.grandline.fruit.funa.ghost_fleet: Three phantom ships sail through the enemy line, firing broadsides at every foe and enemy ship.
fruit.grandline.tenki.desc: ORIGINAL — Weather-Weather Fruit: make weather. Thunderclaps, healing sunshine, soaking rain (real water: it reaches Logia bodies), hail, a thunderstorm cell — and at awakening, change the sky over the world. Immune to lightning; stronger in rain.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenki.thundercla: Lightning called down from a clear sky onto your target.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenki.sunshine.d: A beam of sunlight heals and warms allies and dazzles enemies.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenki.rain_squal: A rain cloud soaks an area: douses fire, wets sand, reaches Logia bodies.
Hailstones pelt an area, freezing and slowing.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenki.storm_cell: A thunderstorm parks over an area, striking a random enemy every second.
ability.grandline.fruit.tenki.change_the: Lightning lashes every enemy around you, and the world's sky turns: clear becomes storm, storm becomes clear.
fruit.grandline.kusuri.desc: ORIGINAL — Medicine-Medicine Fruit: your body brews any drug — remedies and poisons alike. Toxin darts, antidotes, stimulants, anaesthetic, a miracle draught that revives downed crewmates and a cloud that heals friends while poisoning foes. Immune to poison.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusuri.toxin_dar: A dart loaded with a fast-acting toxin.
Cure yourself and nearby allies of every ailment.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusuri.stimulant: Adrenaline for you and nearby allies: speed, strength, haste and stamina — then a short crash.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusuri.anaesthet: A cone of numbing mist: enemies are slowed, weakened and drop their guard.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusuri.miracle_d: Restore the most injured ally nearby by 40% — or bring a knocked-down crewmate back to their feet.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusuri.pharmacop: A vast medicinal cloud: allies heal and are cleansed, enemies are poisoned and withered.
fruit.grandline.wana.desc: ORIGINAL — Trap-Trap Fruit: turn any ground into a trap. Snares, pitfalls, steel jaws, tripwires that expose invisible intruders, iron cages and a minefield. Armed traps are visible only to you; whatever they catch takes 25% more damage from you.
ability.grandline.fruit.wana.snare.desc: A rope snare that snaps shut on the first enemy to step in.
ability.grandline.fruit.wana.pitfall.des: A hidden pit that drops open under the first enemy (temporary).
ability.grandline.fruit.wana.bear_trap.d: Steel jaws that bite deep, pin the victim and make it bleed.
ability.grandline.fruit.wana.tripwire.de: Tripwires around you for half a minute: crossers are tripped, revealed and announced.
ability.grandline.fruit.wana.iron_cage.d: An iron-barred cage drops around the target for a few seconds.
ability.grandline.fruit.wana.minefield.d: Eight hidden mines around a point, each exploding under the first enemy near it.
fruit.grandline.kusari.desc: ORIGINAL — Chain-Chain Fruit: produce and control iron chains. Whips, a grappling hook, binding chains and the Shackle Link — two enemies chained together share half of each other's pain and cannot drift apart.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusari.chain_whi: A lashing chain along a line; the first enemy struck is yanked closer.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusari.chain_hoo: Hook a target and haul it to you — or hook a wall and pull yourself there.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusari.shackle_l: Chain the target to another enemy: half of all damage one takes echoes onto the other.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusari.chain_bin: Chains wrap a target from head to toe: it cannot move or act for a moment.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusari.chain_cyc: Chains whirl around you, battering and reeling in everyone close.
ability.grandline.fruit.kusari.chain_gan: Bind every enemy in the area into one gang: rooted, sharing a third of any damage.
fruit.grandline.nemu.desc: ORIGINAL — Sleep-Sleep Fruit: deal in drowsiness. A contagious yawn, lullabies, a touch that drops foes asleep, nightmares that hurt sleepers without waking them and an Eternal Slumber. Sleepers cannot act (and can be cuffed) until hurt; your first hit on a sleeper deals +50%.
ability.grandline.fruit.nemu.yawn.desc: A contagious yawn: everyone in front grows drowsy (three stacks and they fall asleep).
ability.grandline.fruit.nemu.lullaby.des: Three verses of a lullaby, each adding drowsiness to all enemies around you.
ability.grandline.fruit.nemu.sandman_tou: A pinch of sleep dust: the target drops asleep where it stands.
ability.grandline.fruit.nemu.nightmare.d: Sleepers suffer nightmares that hurt without waking them; the waking are haunted and drowsier.
ability.grandline.fruit.nemu.sleepwalk.d: Drift unseen and untouchable, then reappear behind the target with a Rude Awakening.
ability.grandline.fruit.nemu.eternal_slu: Every enemy in a wide area falls asleep while you and your allies rest and recover.
fruit.grandline.nendo.desc: ORIGINAL — Clay-Clay Fruit (Special Paramecia): a body of living clay. Giant clay fists, clay walls, clay soldiers that fight on their own, remoulding wounds shut, casts that harden around foes and a clay colossus. Absorbs blunt blows; water softens you, fire bakes you hard.
Your arm swells into a giant clay fist and pounds everything along a short line.
A thick wall of clay slapped up in front of you.
ability.grandline.fruit.nendo.clay_soldi: Three soldiers moulded from the ground march on the nearest enemy and pummel it.
ability.grandline.fruit.nendo.remould.de: Knead your body back into shape: wounds close and ailments are pressed out.
Wet clay engulfs the target and hardens into a cast for a few seconds.
ability.grandline.fruit.nendo.clay_colos: A towering clay giant rises and slams its fists down on the nearest enemies.
fruit.grandline.abura.desc: ORIGINAL — Oil-Oil Fruit (Special Paramecia): a body of slick oil. Oiled targets take 75% more from ANY fire, slicks where nobody keeps their footing, a spark that ignites everything oiled (ships included) and a body too slippery to hit. Your oil burns too: fire deals you 50% more.
ability.grandline.fruit.abura.oil_shot.d: A glob of oil: the target (or the ship it splashes) is oiled.
Oil spreads over the ground or sea: nobody keeps their footing on it.
ability.grandline.fruit.abura.ignite.des: A spark: every oiled enemy and ship nearby bursts into flame and your slicks become pools of fire.
ability.grandline.fruit.abura.slippery_b: Coat yourself in oil: almost every blow slides off and you skate around quickly.
ability.grandline.fruit.abura.oil_barrag: Five oil bombs lobbed across an area, each bursting into a small slick.
ability.grandline.fruit.abura.sea_of_fla: A vast slick floods an area and erupts into a sea of fire; enemy ships in it burn.
fruit.grandline.same_megalodon: Same Same no Mi, Model: Megalodon
mastery.grandline.fruit.same_megalodon: Same Same no Mi, Model: Megalodon Mastery
fruit.grandline.same_megalodon.desc: ORIGINAL — Shark-Shark Fruit, Model: Megalodon (Ancient Zoan): become the prehistoric giant shark. Blood-drinking jaws, a fin that swims through solid ground, a blood frenzy, a hull-breaking ram and a maw of the abyss. The cruel joke: the megalodon cannot swim.
ability.grandline.fruit.same_megalodon.t: Cycle human → hybrid → full megalodon (awakened form after awakening).
ability.grandline.fruit.same_megalodon.j: A massive bite that tears flesh (bleeding) and heals you by a quarter of the damage.
ability.grandline.fruit.same_megalodon.g: Dive into the ground and swim through it — only a fin shows — then burst up with a bite.
ability.grandline.fruit.same_megalodon.b: Faster and stronger; wounded enemies glow and take 30% more from you.
ability.grandline.fruit.same_megalodon.h: A ramming charge: creatures are mauled and enemy ships take a hull-splitting blow.
ability.grandline.fruit.same_megalodon.a: A gigantic phantom maw bursts from the ground or sea and snaps shut on everything above it.
fruit.grandline.kame_genbu: Kame Kame no Mi, Model: Genbu
mastery.grandline.fruit.kame_genbu: Kame Kame no Mi, Model: Genbu Mastery
fruit.grandline.kame_genbu.desc: ORIGINAL — Turtle-Turtle Fruit, Model: Genbu (Mythical Zoan): become the Black Tortoise of the North. An uncrackable shell, a venomous serpent tail, northern tides, a ward over the whole crew and the Winter of the North. Blows from behind hit the shell.
ability.grandline.fruit.kame_genbu.trans: Cycle human → hybrid → full Black Tortoise (awakened form after awakening).
ability.grandline.fruit.kame_genbu.shell: Withdraw into the shell: damage nearly nullified, attackers pushed off.
ability.grandline.fruit.kame_genbu.serpe: The serpent coiled about the shell lashes out with a venomous strike.
ability.grandline.fruit.kame_genbu.tidal: A stomp bursts northern water out in a ring — larger beside the sea.
ability.grandline.fruit.kame_genbu.north: Resistance and absorption for the crew nearby; hostile projectiles are knocked from the air.
ability.grandline.fruit.kame_genbu.winte: A towering northern wave crashes down and freezes solid, ground and sea icing over.
fruit.grandline.kaeru_dartfrog: Kaeru Kaeru no Mi, Model: Poison Dart Frog
mastery.grandline.fruit.kaeru_dartfrog: Kaeru Kaeru no Mi, Model: Poison Dart Frog Mastery
fruit.grandline.kaeru_dartfrog.desc: ORIGINAL — Frog-Frog Fruit, Model: Poison Dart Frog (Zoan): a small, brilliant frog with one of the deadliest poisons there is. Sticky tongue, enormous leaps, lethal skin and venom spit. Immune to poison; fire dries you out (+25%).
ability.grandline.fruit.kaeru_dartfrog.t: Cycle human → hybrid → full frog (awakened form after awakening).
A sticky tongue slaps the target and reels it in.
ability.grandline.fruit.kaeru_dartfrog.g: A colossal frog jump that lands in a splash of venom.
ability.grandline.fruit.kaeru_dartfrog.t: Your skin floods with toxin: attackers are badly poisoned and your hits poison too.
ability.grandline.fruit.kaeru_dartfrog.v: An arcing glob of venom that poisons, withers and briefly paralyses.
ability.grandline.fruit.kaeru_dartfrog.p: A monsoon of toxic rain drenches enemies while you and your allies revel in it.
grandline.tenbin.swap: The scales tip: %s ailments passed on, %s blessings taken.
grandline.funa.living_ship: %s comes alive and answers your will.
grandline.tenki.clear: The storm breaks — clear skies over the world.
grandline.tenki.storm: The sky darkens — a storm rolls over the world.
